purpose: Distinguish an activated 3c4e XY2 topology from a weak X...Y2 van der Waals complex after v0.9 structural generation.

ORBITAL_SUBSPACE.role: localized or explicitly projected bonding-subspace analysis
ORBITAL_SUBSPACE.warning: A visual canonical-MO pattern alone is not sufficient.

REAL_SPACE_FORCE.warning: Presence or absence of one QTAIM bond critical point alone is not sufficient.

FRAGMENTATION_ISOMER_ENERGY.role: common-method comparison of activated candidate, weak-complex isomer(s), and preregistered dissociation products
FRAGMENTATION_ISOMER_ENERGY.warning: Stoichiometry or one optimized geometry alone is not sufficient.

aggregation_rule.3c4e: at least two distinct families SUPPORT_3C4E, zero informative families SUPPORT_VDW, and local_minimum=true
aggregation_rule.vdw: at least two distinct families SUPPORT_VDW, zero informative families SUPPORT_3C4E, and local_minimum=true
aggregation_rule.mixed: at least one informative family on each side
aggregation_rule.unknown: fewer than two agreeing informative families, missing local-minimum status, or otherwise unresolved
aggregation_rule.not_local_minimum: REJECTED_NOT_LOCAL_MINIMUM without assigning a stable topology label

important_interpretation: The 2-of-3 rule is a preregistered validation contract, not a physical constant, bond-order threshold, or new Hamiltonian term.

preknown_or_already_opened_exclusions.reason: post-v0.9 lookup already revealed van der Waals isomers
literature existence as a weak complex was encountered before freezing v0.10; exclude from any blind score

scoring.anti_fit: Do not change the structural generator, family list, or 2-of-3 aggregation rule after opening remaining topology labels.

methodological_sources.role: shows NBO/NRT 3c4e analysis and cautions that canonical MO/QTAIM signatures can be misleading for long-bonded cases
high-accuracy multi-descriptor comparison of hypervalent and noncovalent structures
systematic noble-gas halide bonding/stability study across gas and solid-state environments
